Implemented the `ical` CLI in C++20 under [`output/`](./output) with:

- `ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

The project builds with:

```bash
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

I placed the sources in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt) and [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp). I also verified the build succeeds and smoke-tested both subcommands against a sample recurring calendar file.
